source: Manually curated list of 15 genes recurring across multiple unrelated OOF confusion pairs in EXP-374 error analysis (e.g. LUSC<->STES). All 15 are established very long human genes / large-protein-coding genes per general molecular biology knowledge (DMD is the longest human gene; RYR2, SYNE1, PCLO, AHNAK encode very large proteins), consistent with the long-gene passenger-mutation phenomenon described in Lawrence MS et al. 2013, Nature, 'Mutational heterogeneity in cancer and its origin in replication timing and gene expression' (background/passenger mutation rate scales with gene length, independent of driver status). The DOI for that article is not verified here and is deliberately omitted rather than guessed.
source_url: not applicable: no single external downloadable dataset was used for this list; see 'source', 'extraction_policy', and 'selection_policy' for full provenance instead of a URL
extraction_policy: The 15 gene symbols are exactly the competition CSV gene columns identified in the EXP-374 OOF error analysis as passenger-like (recurring across multiple unrelated confusion pairs). No genes were added or removed based on this competition's SUBCLASS distribution or test data; membership was fixed before this experiment's OOF was computed.
selection_policy: Genes were selected purely because they are established long genes/large proteins (an objective, target-independent property), not because of any observed association with SUBCLASS, class frequency, test prevalence, or Public leaderboard score. The list is fixed for this experiment and is not retuned afterward.
organizer_approval_reference: https://github.com/fabxoe/open_cancer/issues/96#issuecomment-5151028180 (same 'fixed external gene-group, competition-CSV-only computed values' category already covered by this comment for pathway burden families)
